arxiv-2103-10023.title: Discriminative and Semantic Feature Selection for Place Recognition towards Dynamic Environments
arxiv-2103-10023.creator: Yuxin Tian, Jinyu Miao, Xingming Wu, Haosong Yue, Zhong Liu, Weihai Chen
arxiv-2103-10023.description: Abstract Features play an important role in various visual tasks, especially in visual place recognition applied in perceptual changing environments. In this paper, we address the challenges of place recognition due to dynamics and confusable patterns by proposing a discriminative and semantic feature selection network, dubbed as DSFeat.

arxiv-2104-06135.title: Multivariate Deep Evidential Regression
arxiv-2104-06135.creator: Nis Meinert, Alexander Lavin
arxiv-2104-06135.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nis Meinert, Alexander Lavin. There is significant need for principled uncertainty reasoning in machine learning systems as they are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains. A new approach with uncertainty-aware neural networks (NNs), based on learning evidential distributions for aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties, shows promise over traditional deterministic methods and typical Bayesian NNs, yet several important gaps in the theory and implementation of these networks remain. We discuss three issues with a proposed solution to extract aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties from regression-based neural networks.

arxiv-2202-09917.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alan Lew, Eran Nevo, Yuval Peled, Orit E. Raz. arxiv-2305-13400.title: Ponderings on the Possible Preponderance of Perpendicular Planets
arxiv-2305-13400.creator: Jared C. Siegel, Joshua N. Winn, Simon H. Albrecht
arxiv-2305-13400.description: Abstract Misalignments between planetary orbits and the equatorial planes of their host stars are clues about the formation and evolution of planetary systems. Earlier work found evidence for a peak near 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} in the distribution of stellar obliquities, based on frequentist tests.

arxiv-2407-08171.title: Examining (Political) Content Consumption on Facebook Through Data Donation
arxiv-2407-08171.creator: Joao Couto, Kiran Garimella
arxiv-2407-08171.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Joao Couto, Kiran Garimella. This paper investigates the usage patterns of Facebook among different demographics in the United States, focusing on the consumption of political information and its variability across age, gender, and ethnicity. Employing a novel data donation model, we developed a tool that allows users to voluntarily share their interactions with public Facebook groups and pages, which we subsequently enrich using CrowdTangle. This approach enabled the collection and analysis of a dataset comprising over 1,200 American users.

arxiv-2408-15707.title: Atmospheric retrievals suggest the presence of a secondary atmosphere and possible sulfur species on L 98-59 d from JWST NIRSpec G395H transmission spectroscopy
arxiv-2408-15707.creator: Agnibha Banerjee, Joanna K. Barstow, Amélie Gressier, Néstor Espinoza, David K. Sing, Natalie H. Allen, Stephan M. Birkmann, Ryan C. Challener, Nicolas Crouzet, Carole A. Haswell, Nikole K. Lewis, Stephen R. Lewis, Jingxuan Yang
arxiv-2408-15707.description: Abstract L 98-59 d is a Super-Earth planet orbiting an M-type star. We performed retrievals on the transmission spectrum of L 98-59 d obtained using NIRSpec G395H during a single transit, from JWST Cycle 1 GTO 1224. The wavelength range of this spectrum allows us to detect the presence of several atmospheric species.

arxiv-2412-05484.description: Abstract Topological entanglement entropy (TEE) is an efficient way to detect topological order in the ground state of gapped Hamiltonians. pmc-12452739.title: Creation of a Novel Coding Program to Identify Genes Controlled by miRNAs During Human Rhinovirus Infection
pmc-12452739.creator: Pax Bosner, Emily Smith, Victoria Cappleman, Alka Tomicic, Ahmed Alrefaey, Ibemusu Michael Otele, Aref Kyyaly, Jamil Jubrail
pmc-12452739.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Human rhinovirus (RV) is the most frequent cause of the common cold, as well as severe exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and asthma. Currently, there are no effective and accurate diagnostic tools or antiviral therapies. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small, non-coding sections of RNA involved in the regulation of gene expression and have been shown to be associated with different pathologies. However, the precise role of miRNAs in RV infection is not yet well established.

pmc-12589318.title: Spatial variation in sexual size dimorphism and mating associations in the color polymorphic Eastern Red-Backed Salamander (Plethodon cinereus)

pmc-12589318.description: Sexual selection due to mate preference for certain traits can maintain phenotypic diversity within populations and species. In taxa with discrete phenotypes, such as color polymorphic species, assortative mating may lead to disruptive selection and sympatric divergence, yet how such interactions vary over species' ranges remains poorly understood.

pmc-12607713.description: Simple SummaryFinches are a large and diverse group of birds found worldwide, yet little is known about the parasites of the family Syringophilidae that live inside their quill feathers. pmc-13614293.creator: Maksym Karachevtsev, Josef Kehrein, Terttu Hukka, Alex Bunker, Mikko Karttunen, Robert Luxenhofer
pmc-13614293.description: Polymeric micelles are established delivery platforms for hydrophobic drugs. All‐atom molecular dynamics simulations are used to investigate drug‐loaded ABA‐type triblock copolymer micelles with a hydrophobic poly(2‐n‐butyl‐2‐oxazine) core and hydrophilic coronas composed of poly(ethylene glycol) (pEG), poly(N,N‐dimethylacrylamide) (pDMAA), and poly(sarcosine) (pSAR).
